💡 optimizerDuck | C#
🎯 Primary Use Case: Optimizing Windows operating systems for better performance and privacy.
✨ Key Features: • Performance optimization • Privacy enhancement • Simplicity of use • Debloating Windows • Open-source
📖 Summary: optimizerDuck is a free, open-source Windows optimization tool designed to enhance system performance, bolster privacy, and simplify user experience. It offers a range of tweaks and debloating options for Windows 10 and above.
